title: Hearing on veterans homelessness in New York City
summary: The Council committees on Veterans and General Welfare will examine the state of veteran homelessness and the housing and support services available to homeless veterans. The hearing will focus on the loss of VA funding for the Borden Avenue Veterans Residence and reported conditions there, including roof leaks and security concerns. As of 2025 there were 697 homeless veterans in New York City, down from 1,558 in 2015 but up from 482 in 2022.
